signs-and-markings.note: Georgia scores road signs as its own exam section, independently of road rules, so a rider who skips signs can fail on that half alone while passing overall, and the baseline withholds signs entirely. Set deliberately below the exam's own signs share: sign questions are quicker to exhaust than the rest of the bank, so mirroring the exam would recycle them faster than a rider improves. A hunch until real p-values replace it.
